migration.description: Additive persistence for OAuth Luna Reserve usage windows, the automatic fallback setting, and its model eligibility policy.
migration.release_unit_description: OAuth Luna Reserve fallback routing change described by ADR 0051.

durable_state.description: Existing OAuth account usage snapshots and pool routing settings remain readable; Reserve fields are nullable and missing observations remain unknown.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Existing SQLite database. Reserve usage columns are nullable additions to pool_upstream_account_limit_samples; automatic_reserve_fallback_enabled defaults to 1, while reserve_fallback_model_policy_mode defaults to upstream and reserve_fallback_model_patterns_json defaults to an empty array.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Existing databases created before Reserve columns and the automatic fallback setting.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create nullable Reserve availability, window, and capture-time columns on pool_upstream_account_limit_samples; preserve all existing rows.
Create automatic_reserve_fallback_enabled on pool_routing_settings with default 1 and backfill legacy rows to enabled.
Create reserve_fallback_model_policy_mode and reserve_fallback_model_patterns_json on pool_routing_settings with upstream and empty-array defaults.

dml_changes.description: New usage samples persist an unknown Reserve snapshot when the upstream response has no structured gpt-reserve data; no absolute balance is fabricated.

progress_signals: Schema migration tests verify additive columns, legacy row readability, default-on fallback, and the default upstream model policy
Account summaries expose Reserve availability, percentages, reset time, and capture time
pause_points: Automatic Reserve fallback can be disabled independently through pool routing settings
Reserve model eligibility can be restricted through the persisted policy mode and patterns

required_test_evidence: Reserve object and array usage parsing
Fallback setting default and toggle behavior
Persisted Reserve model policy defaults and updates
Reserve routing and request rewrite regression tests
